description: Fetch one privacy stack by slug. Most stacks come back whole in this one call. A long stack returns its summary and its layers with the tools in each, in setup order, instead; then pass section (a layer heading) for why each tool and the tradeoffs, or full: true for the whole stack. Slugs come from dp_list_stacks or dp_search.

full.description: Return the whole stack's markdown (long; prefer section).

section.description: A layer heading from sections, to return just that part.

name: dp_get_stack
title: Get one privacy stack
